{{Quote|Not true. I served in Qorvin's Light Battalion. You couldn't pay us to slaughter civilians, unlike these idiots.|A mercenary|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Qorvin''' was the leader and namesake of [[Qorvin's Light Battalion]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] company active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].
